how_to_run: ./install.sh   # S-7: now atomic + preflighted — this is the operator install moment
Open the web UI (default :3100): Inbox, Board (key 8), Worktrees (key 9), Burn view

items.label: Read the new CLAUDE.md install.sh policy paragraph; confirm it matches your intent (deliberate stops, operator-chosen install moments)

Trigger AskUserQuestion in a gated session: it appears once as deferred in the inbox (no permanent duplicate); break a perms bit on a THROWAWAY copy and confirm the denial message walks you to the fix

THE INCIDENT DRILL: on a throwaway HOME, break perms (chmod 644 mode) → confirm the denial message walks you out; run scripts/wisphive-rescue.sh → --fix → gating works again; try rescue.sh --off as the emergency exit
Open the web UI → view 8 (Board): your live sessions appear in lanes; kill an agent and watch it flip to 'stalled · silent 10m' within ~10min; click 'Answer in Inbox →' on a waiting lane

Open view 9 (Worktrees): your real dirty repos appear with generated Conventional Commit messages and per-change agent attribution; copy a message and commit manually — it should pass your CC hooks; confirm there is NO commit/write button anywhere on the strip

Open the Burn view: your sessions show 'activity proxy' tiles (never dollar/token figures); confirm the label 'token spend not observable' is visible; if you have a long read-only session running, check whether the DEAD RUN alert state looks right to you (thresholds: >=10 calls over >=10 min, zero artifacts)

THE INSTALL MOMENT (operator-chosen, per #540): run ./install.sh yourself to pick up all campaign binaries (installed hook is still the 07-14 23:46 build — it predates the actionable denials, brick detector, and statecheck). You should see: staging, codesign, statecheck probe of your real ~/.wisphive (healthy now), atomic swap. Then wisphive doctor for a green bill of health.
